name: task-update-transitional-cli-validation
body: plan_update_task_at still accepts the transitional (kind,tier) CLI arguments and validates them against the defaults "source"/"" because no stored classification exists on the edge-modelled task record. Limit: the update surface carries (kind,tier) only to satisfy transitional validation. Upgrade when phase-5 tasks 5/7 land: remove those transitional CLI arguments and drop the default-based validation.
